instruction: Transform the webpage into PDF format and save it on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving webpage as PDF to Desktop. Evaluator uses progressive scoring to check multiple aspects: file size in range (0.33), valid PDF structure/magic bytes (0.34), and readable pages (0.33). Total score reflects how well the PDF was created, with partial credit for meeting individual criteria.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.33 for file size in range (20-5000 KB), 0.34 for valid PDF magic bytes, 0.33 for having readable pages

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: (1) PDF format transformation via magic bytes check and page readability, (2) Desktop location via file path
Progressive scoring appropriately checks three quality levels: file size range (20-5000 KB is reasonable for webpage PDF), valid PDF structure (magic bytes), and readable pages
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - accesses keys directly from expected dict (not expected.get('rules')) as required for type='rule'
Complete coverage of instruction requirements with appropriate partial credit logic
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Chrome save dialog completes before evaluation, though file operations typically finish before evaluation runs
